scene_description: Two children wearing red winter hats and mittens stand on either side of a snowman in a snowy outdoor setting with snow-covered trees in the background.

questions.question: What are the children building?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big white figure standing between the two children.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tops of the children's heads.

questions.question: Who is standing next to the snowman?
questions.evidence_hint: Look on both sides of the snowman.

questions.question: Where are the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground and all around the children.
